When `run` or `reconstruct` omits `--manifest`, the parser selects this v1 file, whose embedded runner SHA is `a0e821...`, while the committed runner SHA is `67f9d2...`; `validate_repaired_inputs()` therefore always raises `repaired_runner_binding_mismatch_global_stop` even when the caller supplies the correct v1 manifest hash. Point the default at `repaired-frozen-manifest.v4.json`, which is the artifact bound to the committed runner.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve mark-pass failure state during reconstruction**

When all mark-pass attempts fail, `run()` records `mark_pass_failed_after_retries` in the terminal warnings, but checkpoint finalization always passes `None` as `mark_error`. The reconstructed warnings then differ from the terminal row, so the rescore check at lines 758–760 aborts both initial finalization and every later reconstruction for exactly the provider-failure case the checkpoint is meant to preserve. Derive the mark failure from the stored attempt/raw-candidate state instead of discarding it.

+    if type(question_number) is not int or question_number <= 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("question_number_metadata_invalid_global_stop")
+    return FULL_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(question_number=question_number)
+
+
+def _normalize_label(value: Any) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:
+    normalized = base.normalize_label(value)
+    if normalized is not None:
+        return normalized, False
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None, False
+    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "", value.strip().lower())
+    dangling = re.fullmatch(r"([a-z])\(", text)
+    if dangling:
+        return dangling.group(1), True
+    return None, False
+
+
+def _qualify_and_expand(labels: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    qualified: list[str] = []
+    warnings: list[str] = []
+    parent: str | None = None
+    for label in labels:
+        if re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", label):
+            if parent is not None:
+                qualified.append(f"{parent}({label})")
+                warnings.append("bare_roman_subpart_qualified")
+            else:
+                qualified.append(label)
+        else:
+            qualified.append(label)
+            if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]", label):
+                parent = label
+    expanded: list[str] = []
+    for label in qualified:
+        nested = re.fullmatch(r"([a-z])\((?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)\)", label)
+        for value in ([nested.group(1)] if nested else []) + [label]:
+            if value not in expanded:
+                expanded.append(value)
+    if expanded != qualified:
+        warnings.append("nested_parent_label_expanded")
+    return expanded, warnings
+
+
+def _leaf_labels(parts: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    return [part for part in parts if not any(other.startswith(part + "(") for other in parts)]
+
+
+def normalize_full_candidate(
+    candidate: Any, source_question_number: int, *, multi_page: bool = False
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, list[str]]:
+    """Normalize only demonstrated, structurally unambiguous representations."""
+    if not isinstance(candidate, dict):
+        return None, ["full_pass_not_object"]
+    warnings: list[str] = []
+    number = candidate.get("question_number")
+    if isinstance(number, str) and number.strip().isdigit():
+        number = int(number.strip())
+        warnings.append("question_number_string_normalized")
+    if type(number) is not int or number != source_question_number:
+        return None, ["question_identity_mismatch"]
+    raw_parts = candidate.get("visible_subparts")
+    raw_marks = candidate.get("visible_marks")
+    if not isinstance(raw_parts, list) or not isinstance(raw_marks, list):
+        return None, ["full_pass_required_array_missing"]
+
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    edge_repaired_parts: set[str] = set()
+    for value in raw_parts:
+        part, edge_repaired = _normalize_label(value)
+        if part is None or part == "question":
+            return None, ["full_pass_subpart_invalid"]
+        parts.append(part)
+        if edge_repaired:
+            edge_repaired_parts.add(part)
+            warnings.append("single_unmatched_edge_parenthesis_normalized")
+    if len(parts) != len(set(parts)):
+        return None, ["duplicate_subpart_after_normalization"]
+
+    # A leading run of bare Roman labels followed by (b) on a continuation
+    # page has only one structurally consistent owner: (a).  Do not apply the
+    # repair without the following sibling, because standalone Roman labels
+    # are valid printed top-level labels in some papers.
+    roman_count = 0
+    while roman_count < len(parts) and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", parts[roman_count]):
+        roman_count += 1
+    if multi_page and roman_count and parts[roman_count:] == ["b"]:
+        raw_owner_labels = []
+        for row in raw_marks:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                raw_owner_labels = []
+                break
+            raw_owner = row.get("owner", row.get("label"))
+            owner, _ = _normalize_label(raw_owner)
+            raw_owner_labels.append(owner)
+        if raw_owner_labels == parts:
+            parts = ["a"] + [f"a({label})" for label in parts[:roman_count]] + ["b"]
+            warnings.append("multi_page_leading_roman_owner_recovered")
+
+    # A final whole-question mark after a complete, consecutive flat-label
+    # sequence on a continuation page is an unambiguous omitted next sibling.
+    # The exact mark-owner sequence is required; malformed or reordered rows
+    # continue to fail closed.
+    flat_sequence = (
+        bool(parts)
+        and all(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]", part) for part in parts)
+        and parts == [chr(ord("a") + index) for index in range(len(parts))]
+        and len(parts) < 26
+    )
+    recovered_trailing_owner: str | None = None
+    if multi_page and flat_sequence and len(raw_marks) == len(parts) + 1:
+        raw_owner_labels = []
+        for row in raw_marks:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                raw_owner_labels = []
+                break
+            raw_owner = row.get("owner", row.get("label"))
+            owner, _ = _normalize_label(raw_owner)
+            raw_owner_labels.append(owner)
+        if raw_owner_labels == parts + ["question"]:
+            parts.append(chr(ord("a") + len(parts)))
+            recovered_trailing_owner = parts[-1]
+            warnings.append("multi_page_trailing_subpart_owner_recovered")
+
+    parts, label_warnings = _qualify_and_expand(parts)
+    warnings.extend(label_warnings)
+    if len(parts) != len(set(parts)):
+        return None, ["duplicate_subpart_after_normalization"]
+    leaves = _leaf_labels(parts)
+
+    marks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    edge_repaired_owners: set[str] = set()
+    for row in raw_marks:
+        if not isinstance(row, dict):
+            return None, ["full_pass_mark_row_invalid"]
+        has_owner = "owner" in row
+        has_label = "label" in row
+        if has_owner and has_label and row["owner"] != row["label"]:
+            return None, ["conflicting_mark_owner_aliases"]
+        if has_owner:
+            raw_owner = row["owner"]
+        elif has_label:
+            raw_owner = row["label"]
+            warnings.append("mark_label_key_normalized_to_owner")
+        else:
+            raw_owner = None
+        owner_text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", raw_owner.strip().lower()) if isinstance(raw_owner, str) else ""
+        if (
+            recovered_trailing_owner is not None
+            and row is raw_marks[-1]
+            and owner_text in {"question", "whole question", "wholequestion", "whole"}
+        ):
+            owner = recovered_trailing_owner
+        elif len(raw_marks) == 1 and not parts and owner_text in {"question_number", "question number"}:
+            owner = "question"
+            warnings.append("whole_question_owner_alias_normalized")
+        elif (
+            len(raw_marks) == 1
+            and len(leaves) == 1
+            and isinstance(raw_owner, (str, int))
+            and str(raw_owner).strip().isdigit()
+            and int(str(raw_owner).strip()) == source_question_number
+        ):
+            owner = leaves[0]
+            warnings.append("question_identity_owner_to_sole_subpart_normalized")
+        else:
+            owner, edge_repaired = _normalize_label(raw_owner)
+            if edge_repaired:
+                if owner not in edge_repaired_parts:
+                    return None, ["inconsistent_edge_parenthesis_repair"]
+                edge_repaired_owners.add(owner)
+                warnings.append("single_unmatched_edge_parenthesis_normalized")
+            if owner is not None and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", owner):
+                nested_matches = [leaf for leaf in leaves if leaf.endswith(f"({owner})")]
+                if len(nested_matches) == 1:
+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+                    warnings.append("bare_roman_mark_owner_qualified")
+        value = row.get("marks")
+        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().isdigit():
+            value = int(value.strip())
+            warnings.append("mark_value_string_normalized")
+        if owner is None or type(value) is not int or value <= 0:
+            return None, ["full_pass_mark_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+        marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value})
+
+    # Reject parent-owned marks generally, but remove one demonstrably
+    # duplicated parent row when it immediately precedes its first child with
+    # the same value.  This keeps leaf ownership and mark-count gating exact.
+    non_leaf_owners = set(parts) - set(leaves)
+    redundant_parent_indexes = []
+    for index, row in enumerate(marks[:-1]):
+        next_row = marks[index + 1]
+        if (
+            row["owner"] in non_leaf_owners
+            and next_row["owner"].startswith(row["owner"] + "(")
+            and row["marks"] == next_row["marks"]
+        ):
+            redundant_parent_indexes.append(index)
+    if len(redundant_parent_indexes) == 1:
+        filtered = [row for index, row in enumerate(marks) if index != redundant_parent_indexes[0]]
+        if [row["owner"] for row in filtered] == leaves:
+            marks = filtered
+            warnings.append("duplicated_nested_parent_mark_removed")
+
+    owners = [row["owner"] for row in marks]
+    expected_owners = leaves if parts else ["question"]
+    if edge_repaired_parts.intersection(leaves) != edge_repaired_owners:
+        return None, ["inconsistent_edge_parenthesis_repair"]
+    if owners != expected_owners or len(owners) != len(set(owners)):
+        return None, ["mark_owner_structure_mismatch"]
+    writing = candidate.get("candidate_writing_present")
+    annotation = candidate.get("foreign_annotation_present")
+    if type(writing) is not bool or type(annotation) is not bool:
+        return None, ["full_pass_scalar_invalid"]
+    return {
+        "question_number": number,
+        "visible_subparts": parts,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": writing,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": annotation,
+    }, sorted(set(warnings))
+
+
+def evaluate(
+    source: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, mark_candidate: Any, expected: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    first, warnings = normalize_full_candidate(
+        full_candidate,
+        source["question_number"],
+        multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1,
+    )
+    final, disposition, mark_warnings = merge_mark_pass(
+        first, mark_candidate, full_parseable=first is not None
+    )
+    first_checks = batch.checks(first, expected)
+    final_checks = batch.checks(final, expected)
+    warnings = sorted(set(warnings + mark_warnings + [
+        f"field_disagreement:{field}" for field, passed in final_checks.items() if not passed
+    ]))
+    return {
+        "question_id": source["question_id"],
+        "paper_id": source["paper_id"],
+        "question_number": source["question_number"],
+        "page_chain": source["complete_page_chain"],
+        "source_crop_sha256": [row["crop_sha256"] for row in source["regions"]],
+        "strict_full_schema": base.strict_full_schema(full_candidate),
+        "first_pass_normalized": first,
+        "normalized": final,
+        "mark_pass_disposition": disposition,
+        "warnings": warnings,
+        "first_pass_checks": first_checks,
+        "checks": final_checks,
+        "first_pass_all_field_checks_pass": all(first_checks.values()),
+        "all_field_checks_pass": all(final_checks.values()),
+    }
+
+
+def merge_mark_pass(
+    normalized: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    mark_candidate: Any,
+    *,
+    full_parseable: bool,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str, list[str]]:
+    """Merge ownerless values only when positional alignment is fail-closed."""
+    if not full_parseable or normalized is None:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_not_merged_full_unparseable"]
+    if isinstance(mark_candidate, dict) and "visible_marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+        if "marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_multiple_shapes_ambiguous"]
+        rows = mark_candidate["visible_marks_in_reading_order"]
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_rows_invalid"]
+        full_owners = [row["owner"] for row in normalized["visible_marks"]]
+        parsed_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        for row in rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_row_invalid"]
+            owner = base.normalize_label(row.get("owner"))
+            if owner is not None and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", owner):
+                nested_matches = [value for value in full_owners if value.endswith(f"({owner})")]
+                if len(nested_matches) == 1:
+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+            marks = row.get("marks")
+            if owner is None or type(marks) is not int or marks <= 0:
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+            parsed_rows.append({"owner": owner, "marks": marks})
+        parsed_owners = [row["owner"] for row in parsed_rows]
+        if parsed_owners != full_owners:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_sequence_mismatch"]
+        merged = dict(normalized)
+        merged["visible_marks"] = parsed_rows
+        return merged, "merged", []
+    values, error = base.parse_mark_values(mark_candidate)
+    if error:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [error]
+    owners = normalized["visible_marks"]
+    if len(values) != len(owners):
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_count_mismatch:{len(values)}!={len(owners)}"]
+    current = [row["marks"] for row in owners]
+    differing = [index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(current, values)) if before != after]
+    if len(differing) > 1:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_alignment_ambiguous:{len(differing)}_positions"]
+    merged = dict(normalized)
+    merged["visible_marks"] = [
+        {"owner": row["owner"], "marks": value} for row, value in zip(owners, values)
+    ]
+    return merged, "merged", []
+
+
+def terminal_status(
+    evaluated: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, full_error: str | None, mark_error: str | None
+) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    warnings = list(evaluated["warnings"])
+    if full_error:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if mark_error:
+        warnings.append("mark_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if full_error and full_candidate is None:
+        status = "full_pass_failed_after_retries"
+    elif evaluated["normalized"] is None:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_unnormalizable")
+        status = "full_pass_unnormalizable"
+    else:
+        status = "candidate_complete_with_warnings" if warnings else "candidate_complete"
+    return status, sorted(set(warnings))

+def _grid(images: list[Any], gap: int, mode: str) -> Any:
+    Image, _, _ = base._pillow()
+    columns = min(2, len(images))
+    rows = (len(images) + columns - 1) // columns
+    widths = [max((images[i].width for i in range(column, len(images), columns)), default=0) for column in range(columns)]
+    heights = [max(images[i].height for i in range(row * columns, min((row + 1) * columns, len(images)))) for row in range(rows)]
+    canvas = Image.new(mode, (sum(widths) + gap * (columns - 1), sum(heights) + gap * (rows - 1)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for row in range(rows):
+        x = 0
+        for column in range(columns):
+            index = row * columns + column
+            if index < len(images):
+                canvas.paste(images[index], (x, y))
+            x += widths[column] + gap
+        y += heights[row] + gap
+    return canvas
+
+
+def build_question_images(regions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Present multi-page evidence as compact reading-order panels."""
+    if not isinstance(regions, list) or not regions:
+        raise RuntimeError("question_regions_missing_global_stop")
+    Image, ImageEnhance, ImageOps = base._pillow()
+    images = []
+    for region in regions:
+        with Image.open(Path(region["crop_external_path"])) as image:
+            images.append(image.convert("RGB"))
+    full = _grid(images, 30, "RGB")
+    full_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    full.save(full_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=90, optimize=True)
+    strips = []
+    for image in images:
+        strip = image.convert("L").crop((int(image.width * 0.65), 0, image.width, image.height))
+        strip = ImageEnhance.Contrast(ImageOps.autocontrast(strip)).enhance(1.5)
+        strips.append(strip.resize((strip.width * 3, strip.height * 3)))
+    mark = Image.new(
+        "L",
+        (max(strip.width for strip in strips), sum(strip.height for strip in strips) + 60 * (len(strips) - 1)),
+        "white",
+    )
+    mark_y = 0
+    for strip in strips:
+        mark.paste(strip, (0, mark_y))
+        mark_y += strip.height + 60
+    mark_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    mark.save(mark_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=95, optimize=True)
+    return (
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": full_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(full.size)},
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": mark_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(mark.size)},
+    )

+def _verify_attempts(package: Path, pass_name: str, attempts: Any) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(attempts, list) or len(attempts) > MAX_RETRIES + 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_history_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+    for ordinal, record in enumerate(attempts, 1):
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("attempt_number") != ordinal:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_ordinal_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        prefix = package / "attempts" / f"{pass_name}-{ordinal:02d}"
+        metadata = prefix.with_suffix(".metadata.json")
+        request = prefix.with_suffix(".request.json")
+        raw = prefix.with_suffix(".response.raw.json")
+        if not metadata.is_file() or read_json(metadata) != record:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_metadata_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        if not request.is_file() or read_json(request) != record.get("request"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_request_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        response_sha = record.get("response_sha256")
+        if response_sha is not None and (not raw.is_file() or sha256_file(raw) != response_sha):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_response_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")

+def _comparison(summary: dict[str, Any], rows: list[dict[str, Any]], selection: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    baseline_summary = read_json(PARENT_SUMMARY)
+    baseline = index_rows(read_json(PARENT_CANDIDATES)["rows"], "question_id", "baseline_candidate")
+    current = index_rows(rows, "question_id", "current_candidate")
+    original_correct = {question_id for question_id, row in baseline.items() if row["all_field_checks_pass"]}
+    regressions = sorted(question_id for question_id in original_correct if question_id in current and not current[question_id]["all_field_checks_pass"])
+    before_after = {
+        "strict_schema": {"before": baseline_summary["strict_full_schema"], "after": summary["strict_full_schema"]},
+        "fully_correct": {"before": baseline_summary["final_end_to_end"], "after": summary["final_end_to_end"]},
+    }
+    for field in batch.FIELDS:
+        before_after[field] = {
+            "before": baseline_summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+            "after": summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+        }
+    return {
+        "immutable_baseline_issue": 1629,
+        "immutable_baseline_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+        "selection": selection,
+        "before_after": before_after,
+        "normalization_failures": {
+            "before": baseline_summary["provider"]["terminal_full_unnormalizable_count"],
+            "after": sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows),
+        },
+        "model_disagreements_after": sum(row["normalized"] is not None and not row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows),
+        "original_correct_row_count": len(original_correct),
+        "original_correct_regression_count": len(regressions),
+        "original_correct_regression_question_ids": regressions,
+    }

+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:

+    summary.update({

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce the manifest's independent-truth binding**

When a caller supplies `--truth`, validation checks only the candidate-blind flag, parent hash, and question-ID membership; it never compares the supplied path or SHA-256 with `manifest["independent_truth"]`. A different repo-local JSON file with altered `expected` values can therefore pass validation and silently rescore the experiment against truth other than the frozen truth bound into the manifest. Resolve the manifest-bound path and verify both it and its hash before loading rows.

+                warnings.append("bare_roman_subpart_qualified")
+            else:
+                qualified.append(label)
+        else:
+            qualified.append(label)
+            if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]", label):
+                parent = label
+    expanded: list[str] = []
+    for label in qualified:
+        nested = re.fullmatch(r"([a-z])\((?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)\)", label)
+        for value in ([nested.group(1)] if nested else []) + [label]:
+            if value not in expanded:
+                expanded.append(value)
+    if expanded != qualified:
+        warnings.append("nested_parent_label_expanded")
+    return expanded, warnings
+
+
+def _leaf_labels(parts: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    return [part for part in parts if not any(other.startswith(part + "(") for other in parts)]
+
+
+def normalize_full_candidate(
+    candidate: Any, source_question_number: int, *, multi_page: bool = False
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, list[str]]:
+    """Normalize only demonstrated, structurally unambiguous representations."""
+    if not isinstance(candidate, dict):
+        return None, ["full_pass_not_object"]
+    warnings: list[str] = []
+    number = candidate.get("question_number")
+    if isinstance(number, str) and number.strip().isdigit():
+        number = int(number.strip())
+        warnings.append("question_number_string_normalized")
+    if type(number) is not int or number != source_question_number:
+        return None, ["question_identity_mismatch"]
+    raw_parts = candidate.get("visible_subparts")
+    raw_marks = candidate.get("visible_marks")
+    if not isinstance(raw_parts, list) or not isinstance(raw_marks, list):
+        return None, ["full_pass_required_array_missing"]
+
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    edge_repaired_parts: set[str] = set()
+    for value in raw_parts:
+        part, edge_repaired = _normalize_label(value)
+        if part is None or part == "question":
+            return None, ["full_pass_subpart_invalid"]
+        parts.append(part)
+        if edge_repaired:
+            edge_repaired_parts.add(part)
+            warnings.append("single_unmatched_edge_parenthesis_normalized")
+    if len(parts) != len(set(parts)):
+        return None, ["duplicate_subpart_after_normalization"]
+
+    # A leading run of bare Roman labels followed by (b) on a continuation
+    # page has only one structurally consistent owner: (a).  Do not apply the
+    # repair without the following sibling, because standalone Roman labels
+    # are valid printed top-level labels in some papers.
+    roman_count = 0
+    while roman_count < len(parts) and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", parts[roman_count]):
+        roman_count += 1
+    if multi_page and roman_count and parts[roman_count:] == ["b"]:
+        raw_owner_labels = []
+        for row in raw_marks:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                raw_owner_labels = []
+                break
+            raw_owner = row.get("owner", row.get("label"))
+            owner, _ = _normalize_label(raw_owner)
+            raw_owner_labels.append(owner)
+        if raw_owner_labels == parts:
+            parts = ["a"] + [f"a({label})" for label in parts[:roman_count]] + ["b"]
+            warnings.append("multi_page_leading_roman_owner_recovered")
+
+    # A final whole-question mark after a complete, consecutive flat-label
+    # sequence on a continuation page is an unambiguous omitted next sibling.
+    # The exact mark-owner sequence is required; malformed or reordered rows
+    # continue to fail closed.
+    flat_sequence = (
+        bool(parts)
+        and all(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]", part) for part in parts)
+        and parts == [chr(ord("a") + index) for index in range(len(parts))]
+        and len(parts) < 26
+    )
+    recovered_trailing_owner: str | None = None
+    if multi_page and flat_sequence and len(raw_marks) == len(parts) + 1:
+        raw_owner_labels = []
+        for row in raw_marks:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                raw_owner_labels = []
+                break
+            raw_owner = row.get("owner", row.get("label"))
+            owner, _ = _normalize_label(raw_owner)
+            raw_owner_labels.append(owner)
+        if raw_owner_labels == parts + ["question"]:
+            parts.append(chr(ord("a") + len(parts)))
+            recovered_trailing_owner = parts[-1]
+            warnings.append("multi_page_trailing_subpart_owner_recovered")
+
+    parts, label_warnings = _qualify_and_expand(parts)
+    warnings.extend(label_warnings)
+    if len(parts) != len(set(parts)):
+        return None, ["duplicate_subpart_after_normalization"]
+    leaves = _leaf_labels(parts)
+
+    marks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    edge_repaired_owners: set[str] = set()
+    for row in raw_marks:
+        if not isinstance(row, dict):
+            return None, ["full_pass_mark_row_invalid"]
+        has_owner = "owner" in row
+        has_label = "label" in row
+        if has_owner and has_label and row["owner"] != row["label"]:
+            return None, ["conflicting_mark_owner_aliases"]
+        if has_owner:
+            raw_owner = row["owner"]
+        elif has_label:
+            raw_owner = row["label"]
+            warnings.append("mark_label_key_normalized_to_owner")
+        else:
+            raw_owner = None
+        owner_text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", raw_owner.strip().lower()) if isinstance(raw_owner, str) else ""
+        if (
+            recovered_trailing_owner is not None
+            and row is raw_marks[-1]
+            and owner_text in {"question", "whole question", "wholequestion", "whole"}
+        ):
+            owner = recovered_trailing_owner
+        elif len(raw_marks) == 1 and not parts and owner_text in {"question_number", "question number"}:
+            owner = "question"
+            warnings.append("whole_question_owner_alias_normalized")
+        elif (
+            len(raw_marks) == 1
+            and len(leaves) == 1
+            and isinstance(raw_owner, (str, int))
+            and str(raw_owner).strip().isdigit()
+            and int(str(raw_owner).strip()) == source_question_number
+        ):
+            owner = leaves[0]
+            warnings.append("question_identity_owner_to_sole_subpart_normalized")
+        else:
+            owner, edge_repaired = _normalize_label(raw_owner)
+            if edge_repaired:
+                if owner not in edge_repaired_parts:
+                    return None, ["inconsistent_edge_parenthesis_repair"]
+                edge_repaired_owners.add(owner)
+                warnings.append("single_unmatched_edge_parenthesis_normalized")
+            if owner is not None and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", owner):
+                nested_matches = [leaf for leaf in leaves if leaf.endswith(f"({owner})")]
+                if len(nested_matches) == 1:
+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+                    warnings.append("bare_roman_mark_owner_qualified")
+        value = row.get("marks")
+        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().isdigit():
+            value = int(value.strip())
+            warnings.append("mark_value_string_normalized")
+        if owner is None or type(value) is not int or value <= 0:
+            return None, ["full_pass_mark_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+        marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value})
+
+    # Reject parent-owned marks generally, but remove one demonstrably
+    # duplicated parent row when it immediately precedes its first child with
+    # the same value.  This keeps leaf ownership and mark-count gating exact.
+    non_leaf_owners = set(parts) - set(leaves)
+    redundant_parent_indexes = []
+    for index, row in enumerate(marks[:-1]):
+        next_row = marks[index + 1]
+        if (
+            row["owner"] in non_leaf_owners
+            and next_row["owner"].startswith(row["owner"] + "(")
+            and row["marks"] == next_row["marks"]
+        ):
+            redundant_parent_indexes.append(index)
+    if len(redundant_parent_indexes) == 1:
+        filtered = [row for index, row in enumerate(marks) if index != redundant_parent_indexes[0]]
+        if [row["owner"] for row in filtered] == leaves:
+            marks = filtered
+            warnings.append("duplicated_nested_parent_mark_removed")
+
+    owners = [row["owner"] for row in marks]
+    expected_owners = leaves if parts else ["question"]
+    if edge_repaired_parts.intersection(leaves) != edge_repaired_owners:
+        return None, ["inconsistent_edge_parenthesis_repair"]
+    if owners != expected_owners or len(owners) != len(set(owners)):
+        return None, ["mark_owner_structure_mismatch"]
+    writing = candidate.get("candidate_writing_present")
+    annotation = candidate.get("foreign_annotation_present")
+    if type(writing) is not bool or type(annotation) is not bool:
+        return None, ["full_pass_scalar_invalid"]
+    return {
+        "question_number": number,
+        "visible_subparts": parts,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": writing,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": annotation,
+    }, sorted(set(warnings))
+
+
+def evaluate(
+    source: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, mark_candidate: Any, expected: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    first, warnings = normalize_full_candidate(
+        full_candidate,
+        source["question_number"],
+        multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1,
+    )
+    final, disposition, mark_warnings = merge_mark_pass(
+        first, mark_candidate, full_parseable=first is not None
+    )
+    first_checks = batch.checks(first, expected)
+    final_checks = batch.checks(final, expected)
+    warnings = sorted(set(warnings + mark_warnings + [
+        f"field_disagreement:{field}" for field, passed in final_checks.items() if not passed
+    ]))
+    return {
+        "question_id": source["question_id"],
+        "paper_id": source["paper_id"],
+        "question_number": source["question_number"],
+        "page_chain": source["complete_page_chain"],
+        "source_crop_sha256": [row["crop_sha256"] for row in source["regions"]],
+        "strict_full_schema": base.strict_full_schema(full_candidate),
+        "first_pass_normalized": first,
+        "normalized": final,
+        "mark_pass_disposition": disposition,
+        "warnings": warnings,
+        "first_pass_checks": first_checks,
+        "checks": final_checks,
+        "first_pass_all_field_checks_pass": all(first_checks.values()),
+        "all_field_checks_pass": all(final_checks.values()),
+    }
+
+
+def merge_mark_pass(
+    normalized: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    mark_candidate: Any,
+    *,
+    full_parseable: bool,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str, list[str]]:
+    """Merge ownerless values only when positional alignment is fail-closed."""
+    if not full_parseable or normalized is None:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_not_merged_full_unparseable"]
+    if isinstance(mark_candidate, dict) and "visible_marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+        if "marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_multiple_shapes_ambiguous"]
+        rows = mark_candidate["visible_marks_in_reading_order"]
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_rows_invalid"]
+        full_owners = [row["owner"] for row in normalized["visible_marks"]]
+        parsed_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        for row in rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_row_invalid"]
+            owner = base.normalize_label(row.get("owner"))
+            if owner is not None and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", owner):
+                nested_matches = [value for value in full_owners if value.endswith(f"({owner})")]
+                if len(nested_matches) == 1:
+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+            marks = row.get("marks")
+            if owner is None or type(marks) is not int or marks <= 0:
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+            parsed_rows.append({"owner": owner, "marks": marks})
+        parsed_owners = [row["owner"] for row in parsed_rows]
+        if parsed_owners != full_owners:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_sequence_mismatch"]
+        merged = dict(normalized)
+        merged["visible_marks"] = parsed_rows
+        return merged, "merged", []
+    values, error = base.parse_mark_values(mark_candidate)
+    if error:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [error]
+    owners = normalized["visible_marks"]
+    if len(values) != len(owners):
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_count_mismatch:{len(values)}!={len(owners)}"]
+    current = [row["marks"] for row in owners]
+    differing = [index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(current, values)) if before != after]
+    if len(differing) > 1:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_alignment_ambiguous:{len(differing)}_positions"]
+    merged = dict(normalized)
+    merged["visible_marks"] = [
+        {"owner": row["owner"], "marks": value} for row, value in zip(owners, values)
+    ]
+    return merged, "merged", []
+
+
+def terminal_status(
+    evaluated: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, full_error: str | None, mark_error: str | None
+) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    warnings = list(evaluated["warnings"])
+    if full_error:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if mark_error:
+        warnings.append("mark_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if full_error and full_candidate is None:
+        status = "full_pass_failed_after_retries"
+    elif evaluated["normalized"] is None:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_unnormalizable")
+        status = "full_pass_unnormalizable"
+    else:
+        status = "candidate_complete_with_warnings" if warnings else "candidate_complete"
+    return status, sorted(set(warnings))
+
+
+def _grid(images: list[Any], gap: int, mode: str) -> Any:
+    Image, _, _ = base._pillow()
+    columns = min(2, len(images))
+    rows = (len(images) + columns - 1) // columns
+    widths = [max((images[i].width for i in range(column, len(images), columns)), default=0) for column in range(columns)]
+    heights = [max(images[i].height for i in range(row * columns, min((row + 1) * columns, len(images)))) for row in range(rows)]
+    canvas = Image.new(mode, (sum(widths) + gap * (columns - 1), sum(heights) + gap * (rows - 1)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for row in range(rows):
+        x = 0
+        for column in range(columns):
+            index = row * columns + column
+            if index < len(images):
+                canvas.paste(images[index], (x, y))
+            x += widths[column] + gap
+        y += heights[row] + gap
+    return canvas
+
+
+def build_question_images(regions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Present multi-page evidence as compact reading-order panels."""
+    if not isinstance(regions, list) or not regions:
+        raise RuntimeError("question_regions_missing_global_stop")
+    Image, ImageEnhance, ImageOps = base._pillow()
+    images = []
+    for region in regions:
+        with Image.open(Path(region["crop_external_path"])) as image:
+            images.append(image.convert("RGB"))
+    full = _grid(images, 30, "RGB")
+    full_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    full.save(full_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=90, optimize=True)
+    strips = []
+    for image in images:
+        strip = image.convert("L").crop((int(image.width * 0.65), 0, image.width, image.height))
+        strip = ImageEnhance.Contrast(ImageOps.autocontrast(strip)).enhance(1.5)
+        strips.append(strip.resize((strip.width * 3, strip.height * 3)))
+    mark = Image.new(
+        "L",
+        (max(strip.width for strip in strips), sum(strip.height for strip in strips) + 60 * (len(strips) - 1)),
+        "white",
+    )
+    mark_y = 0
+    for strip in strips:
+        mark.paste(strip, (0, mark_y))
+        mark_y += strip.height + 60
+    mark_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    mark.save(mark_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=95, optimize=True)
+    return (
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": full_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(full.size)},
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": mark_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(mark.size)},
+    )

+def _verify_attempts(package: Path, pass_name: str, attempts: Any) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(attempts, list) or len(attempts) > MAX_RETRIES + 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_history_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+    for ordinal, record in enumerate(attempts, 1):
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("attempt_number") != ordinal:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_ordinal_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        prefix = package / "attempts" / f"{pass_name}-{ordinal:02d}"
+        metadata = prefix.with_suffix(".metadata.json")
+        request = prefix.with_suffix(".request.json")
+        raw = prefix.with_suffix(".response.raw.json")
+        if not metadata.is_file() or read_json(metadata) != record:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_metadata_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        if not request.is_file() or read_json(request) != record.get("request"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_request_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        response_sha = record.get("response_sha256")
+        if response_sha is not None and (not raw.is_file() or sha256_file(raw) != response_sha):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_response_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")

+def _comparison(summary: dict[str, Any], rows: list[dict[str, Any]], selection: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    baseline_summary = read_json(PARENT_SUMMARY)
+    baseline = index_rows(read_json(PARENT_CANDIDATES)["rows"], "question_id", "baseline_candidate")
+    current = index_rows(rows, "question_id", "current_candidate")
+    original_correct = {question_id for question_id, row in baseline.items() if row["all_field_checks_pass"]}
+    regressions = sorted(question_id for question_id in original_correct if question_id in current and not current[question_id]["all_field_checks_pass"])
+    before_after = {
+        "strict_schema": {"before": baseline_summary["strict_full_schema"], "after": summary["strict_full_schema"]},
+        "fully_correct": {"before": baseline_summary["final_end_to_end"], "after": summary["final_end_to_end"]},
+    }
+    for field in batch.FIELDS:
+        before_after[field] = {
+            "before": baseline_summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+            "after": summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+        }
+    return {
+        "immutable_baseline_issue": 1629,
+        "immutable_baseline_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+        "selection": selection,
+        "before_after": before_after,
+        "normalization_failures": {
+            "before": baseline_summary["provider"]["terminal_full_unnormalizable_count"],
+            "after": sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows),
+        },
+        "model_disagreements_after": sum(row["normalized"] is not None and not row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows),
+        "original_correct_row_count": len(original_correct),
+        "original_correct_regression_count": len(regressions),
+        "original_correct_regression_question_ids": regressions,
+    }

+def _documents(
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]], manifest: dict[str, Any], truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    selected: list[str], selection: str, truth_path: Path, runner_sha: str
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    questions = index_rows(manifest["questions"], "question_id", "manifest_question")
+    selected_manifest = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
+    selected_manifest["questions"] = [questions[question_id] for question_id in selected]
+    selected_truth = {question_id: truth[question_id] for question_id in selected}
+    provenance = {
+        "mode": "candidate_blind_official_page_repair",
+        "path": truth_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(truth_path),
+        "parent_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+    }
+    summary, candidates, residual = batch.finalize(rows, selected_manifest, selected_truth, provenance)
+    normalization_failures = sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows)
+    model_disagreements = sum(row["normalized"] is not None and not row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    summary.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_validation_summary_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "scope": f"{selection}_{len(selected)}",
+        "paper_count": len({row["paper_id"] for row in rows}),
+        "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
+        "repair_runner_file_sha256": runner_sha,
+        "normalization_failure_count": normalization_failures,
+        "model_disagreement_count": model_disagreements,
+        "residual_category_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(
+            "normalization_failure" if row["normalized"] is None else "model_disagreement"
+            for row in rows if not row["all_field_checks_pass"]
+        ).items())),
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+        "repaired_set_is_not_an_independent_holdout": True,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    summary["comparison"] = _comparison(summary, rows, selection)
+    candidates.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_candidate_results_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    residual.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_residual_review_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    inventory = batch.raw_hash_inventory(rows)
+    inventory.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_raw_hash_inventory_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    return summary, candidates, residual, inventory

+def _write_documents(output_dir: Path, documents: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for name, document in zip(COMPACT_NAMES, documents):

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reparse raw responses before rescoring checkpoints**

Checkpoint finalization scores the separately stored `raw_candidate` without verifying that it is the value parsed from the response file authenticated by the attempt's `response_sha256`. If a terminal/checkpoint candidate is corrupted or edited while its attempt metadata and raw response remain intact, reconstruction can publish scores for output the model never returned; the sidecar equality check only compares two copies of the same terminal data. Reparse the verified raw response and require it to equal `raw_candidate` before evaluation.

+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+                    warnings.append("bare_roman_mark_owner_qualified")
+        value = row.get("marks")
+        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().isdigit():
+            value = int(value.strip())
+            warnings.append("mark_value_string_normalized")
+        if owner is None or type(value) is not int or value <= 0:
+            return None, ["full_pass_mark_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+        marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value})
+
+    # Reject parent-owned marks generally, but remove one demonstrably
+    # duplicated parent row when it immediately precedes its first child with
+    # the same value.  This keeps leaf ownership and mark-count gating exact.
+    non_leaf_owners = set(parts) - set(leaves)
+    redundant_parent_indexes = []
+    for index, row in enumerate(marks[:-1]):
+        next_row = marks[index + 1]
+        if (
+            row["owner"] in non_leaf_owners
+            and next_row["owner"].startswith(row["owner"] + "(")
+            and row["marks"] == next_row["marks"]
+        ):
+            redundant_parent_indexes.append(index)
+    if len(redundant_parent_indexes) == 1:
+        filtered = [row for index, row in enumerate(marks) if index != redundant_parent_indexes[0]]
+        if [row["owner"] for row in filtered] == leaves:
+            marks = filtered
+            warnings.append("duplicated_nested_parent_mark_removed")
+
+    owners = [row["owner"] for row in marks]
+    expected_owners = leaves if parts else ["question"]
+    if edge_repaired_parts.intersection(leaves) != edge_repaired_owners:
+        return None, ["inconsistent_edge_parenthesis_repair"]
+    if owners != expected_owners or len(owners) != len(set(owners)):
+        return None, ["mark_owner_structure_mismatch"]
+    writing = candidate.get("candidate_writing_present")
+    annotation = candidate.get("foreign_annotation_present")
+    if type(writing) is not bool or type(annotation) is not bool:
+        return None, ["full_pass_scalar_invalid"]
+    return {
+        "question_number": number,
+        "visible_subparts": parts,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": writing,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": annotation,
+    }, sorted(set(warnings))
+
+
+def evaluate(
+    source: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, mark_candidate: Any, expected: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    first, warnings = normalize_full_candidate(
+        full_candidate,
+        source["question_number"],
+        multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1,
+    )
+    final, disposition, mark_warnings = merge_mark_pass(
+        first, mark_candidate, full_parseable=first is not None
+    )
+    first_checks = batch.checks(first, expected)
+    final_checks = batch.checks(final, expected)
+    warnings = sorted(set(warnings + mark_warnings + [
+        f"field_disagreement:{field}" for field, passed in final_checks.items() if not passed
+    ]))
+    return {
+        "question_id": source["question_id"],
+        "paper_id": source["paper_id"],
+        "question_number": source["question_number"],
+        "page_chain": source["complete_page_chain"],
+        "source_crop_sha256": [row["crop_sha256"] for row in source["regions"]],
+        "strict_full_schema": base.strict_full_schema(full_candidate),
+        "first_pass_normalized": first,
+        "normalized": final,
+        "mark_pass_disposition": disposition,
+        "warnings": warnings,
+        "first_pass_checks": first_checks,
+        "checks": final_checks,
+        "first_pass_all_field_checks_pass": all(first_checks.values()),
+        "all_field_checks_pass": all(final_checks.values()),
+    }

+def merge_mark_pass(
+    normalized: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    mark_candidate: Any,
+    *,
+    full_parseable: bool,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str, list[str]]:
+    """Merge ownerless values only when positional alignment is fail-closed."""
+    if not full_parseable or normalized is None:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_not_merged_full_unparseable"]
+    if isinstance(mark_candidate, dict) and "visible_marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+        if "marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_multiple_shapes_ambiguous"]
+        rows = mark_candidate["visible_marks_in_reading_order"]
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_rows_invalid"]
+        full_owners = [row["owner"] for row in normalized["visible_marks"]]
+        parsed_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        for row in rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_row_invalid"]
+            owner = base.normalize_label(row.get("owner"))
+            if owner is not None and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", owner):
+                nested_matches = [value for value in full_owners if value.endswith(f"({owner})")]
+                if len(nested_matches) == 1:
+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+            marks = row.get("marks")
+            if owner is None or type(marks) is not int or marks <= 0:
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+            parsed_rows.append({"owner": owner, "marks": marks})
+        parsed_owners = [row["owner"] for row in parsed_rows]
+        if parsed_owners != full_owners:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_sequence_mismatch"]
+        merged = dict(normalized)
+        merged["visible_marks"] = parsed_rows
+        return merged, "merged", []
+    values, error = base.parse_mark_values(mark_candidate)
+    if error:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [error]
+    owners = normalized["visible_marks"]
+    if len(values) != len(owners):
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_count_mismatch:{len(values)}!={len(owners)}"]
+    current = [row["marks"] for row in owners]
+    differing = [index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(current, values)) if before != after]
+    if len(differing) > 1:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_alignment_ambiguous:{len(differing)}_positions"]
+    merged = dict(normalized)
+    merged["visible_marks"] = [
+        {"owner": row["owner"], "marks": value} for row, value in zip(owners, values)
+    ]
+    return merged, "merged", []
+
+
+def terminal_status(
+    evaluated: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, full_error: str | None, mark_error: str | None
+) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    warnings = list(evaluated["warnings"])
+    if full_error:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if mark_error:
+        warnings.append("mark_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if full_error and full_candidate is None:
+        status = "full_pass_failed_after_retries"
+    elif evaluated["normalized"] is None:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_unnormalizable")
+        status = "full_pass_unnormalizable"
+    else:
+        status = "candidate_complete_with_warnings" if warnings else "candidate_complete"
+    return status, sorted(set(warnings))
+

+def _grid(images: list[Any], gap: int, mode: str) -> Any:
+    Image, _, _ = base._pillow()
+    columns = min(2, len(images))
+    rows = (len(images) + columns - 1) // columns
+    widths = [max((images[i].width for i in range(column, len(images), columns)), default=0) for column in range(columns)]
+    heights = [max(images[i].height for i in range(row * columns, min((row + 1) * columns, len(images)))) for row in range(rows)]
+    canvas = Image.new(mode, (sum(widths) + gap * (columns - 1), sum(heights) + gap * (rows - 1)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for row in range(rows):
+        x = 0
+        for column in range(columns):
+            index = row * columns + column
+            if index < len(images):
+                canvas.paste(images[index], (x, y))
+            x += widths[column] + gap
+        y += heights[row] + gap
+    return canvas
+
+
+def build_question_images(regions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Present multi-page evidence as compact reading-order panels."""
+    if not isinstance(regions, list) or not regions:
+        raise RuntimeError("question_regions_missing_global_stop")
+    Image, ImageEnhance, ImageOps = base._pillow()
+    images = []
+    for region in regions:
+        with Image.open(Path(region["crop_external_path"])) as image:
+            images.append(image.convert("RGB"))
+    full = _grid(images, 30, "RGB")
+    full_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    full.save(full_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=90, optimize=True)
+    strips = []
+    for image in images:
+        strip = image.convert("L").crop((int(image.width * 0.65), 0, image.width, image.height))
+        strip = ImageEnhance.Contrast(ImageOps.autocontrast(strip)).enhance(1.5)
+        strips.append(strip.resize((strip.width * 3, strip.height * 3)))
+    mark = Image.new(
+        "L",
+        (max(strip.width for strip in strips), sum(strip.height for strip in strips) + 60 * (len(strips) - 1)),
+        "white",
+    )
+    mark_y = 0
+    for strip in strips:
+        mark.paste(strip, (0, mark_y))
+        mark_y += strip.height + 60
+    mark_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    mark.save(mark_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=95, optimize=True)
+    return (
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": full_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(full.size)},
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": mark_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(mark.size)},
+    )
+

+def _verify_attempts(package: Path, pass_name: str, attempts: Any) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(attempts, list) or len(attempts) > MAX_RETRIES + 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_history_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+    for ordinal, record in enumerate(attempts, 1):
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("attempt_number") != ordinal:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_ordinal_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        prefix = package / "attempts" / f"{pass_name}-{ordinal:02d}"
+        metadata = prefix.with_suffix(".metadata.json")
+        request = prefix.with_suffix(".request.json")
+        raw = prefix.with_suffix(".response.raw.json")
+        if not metadata.is_file() or read_json(metadata) != record:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_metadata_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        if not request.is_file() or read_json(request) != record.get("request"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_request_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        response_sha = record.get("response_sha256")
+        if response_sha is not None and (not raw.is_file() or sha256_file(raw) != response_sha):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_response_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")

+def _comparison(summary: dict[str, Any], rows: list[dict[str, Any]], selection: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    baseline_summary = read_json(PARENT_SUMMARY)
+    baseline = index_rows(read_json(PARENT_CANDIDATES)["rows"], "question_id", "baseline_candidate")
+    current = index_rows(rows, "question_id", "current_candidate")
+    original_correct = {question_id for question_id, row in baseline.items() if row["all_field_checks_pass"]}
+    regressions = sorted(question_id for question_id in original_correct if question_id in current and not current[question_id]["all_field_checks_pass"])
+    before_after = {
+        "strict_schema": {"before": baseline_summary["strict_full_schema"], "after": summary["strict_full_schema"]},
+        "fully_correct": {"before": baseline_summary["final_end_to_end"], "after": summary["final_end_to_end"]},
+    }
+    for field in batch.FIELDS:
+        before_after[field] = {
+            "before": baseline_summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+            "after": summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+        }
+    return {
+        "immutable_baseline_issue": 1629,
+        "immutable_baseline_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+        "selection": selection,
+        "before_after": before_after,
+        "normalization_failures": {
+            "before": baseline_summary["provider"]["terminal_full_unnormalizable_count"],
+            "after": sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows),
+        },
+        "model_disagreements_after": sum(row["normalized"] is not None and not row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows),
+        "original_correct_row_count": len(original_correct),
+        "original_correct_regression_count": len(regressions),
+        "original_correct_regression_question_ids": regressions,
+    }

+def _documents(
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]], manifest: dict[str, Any], truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    selected: list[str], selection: str, truth_path: Path, runner_sha: str
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    questions = index_rows(manifest["questions"], "question_id", "manifest_question")
+    selected_manifest = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
+    selected_manifest["questions"] = [questions[question_id] for question_id in selected]
+    selected_truth = {question_id: truth[question_id] for question_id in selected}
+    provenance = {
+        "mode": "candidate_blind_official_page_repair",
+        "path": truth_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(truth_path),
+        "parent_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+    }
+    summary, candidates, residual = batch.finalize(rows, selected_manifest, selected_truth, provenance)
+    normalization_failures = sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows)
+    model_disagreements = sum(row["normalized"] is not None and not row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    summary.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_validation_summary_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "scope": f"{selection}_{len(selected)}",
+        "paper_count": len({row["paper_id"] for row in rows}),
+        "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
+        "repair_runner_file_sha256": runner_sha,
+        "normalization_failure_count": normalization_failures,
+        "model_disagreement_count": model_disagreements,
+        "residual_category_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(
+            "normalization_failure" if row["normalized"] is None else "model_disagreement"
+            for row in rows if not row["all_field_checks_pass"]
+        ).items())),
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+        "repaired_set_is_not_an_independent_holdout": True,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    summary["comparison"] = _comparison(summary, rows, selection)
+    candidates.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_candidate_results_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    residual.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_residual_review_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    inventory = batch.raw_hash_inventory(rows)
+    inventory.update({
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_residual_repair_raw_hash_inventory_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+    })
+    return summary, candidates, residual, inventory

+def finalize_from_checkpoint(
+    *, checkpoint: Path, run_root: Path, output_dir: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any],
+    truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], manifest_sha: str, truth_path: Path,
+    selected: list[str], selection: str, run_id: str, runner_sha: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """The only compact-artifact finalization path; always deserialize checkpoint bytes."""
+    selection_sha = sha256_bytes(batch.canonical_bytes(selected))
+    indexed = index_rows(batch.load_checkpoint(checkpoint), "question_id", "checkpoint")
+    if set(indexed) != set(selected):
+        raise RuntimeError("checkpoint_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    sources = index_rows(manifest["questions"], "question_id", "source_question")
+    rescored: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for question_id in selected:
+        row = indexed[question_id]
+        validate_terminal(
+            row, question_id=question_id, run_id=run_id, manifest_sha=manifest_sha,
+            truth_sha=sha256_file(truth_path), selection_sha=selection_sha, runner_sha=runner_sha,
+        )
+        package = run_root / "questions" / question_id
+        sidecar = package / "terminal-row.json"
+        if not sidecar.is_file() or sidecar.read_bytes() != batch.canonical_bytes(row):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"terminal_sidecar_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        _verify_attempts(package, "full", row.get("full_pass", {}).get("attempts"))
+        _verify_attempts(package, "mark", row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("attempts"))
+        source = sources[question_id]
+        full_image, mark_image = build_question_images(source["regions"])
+        expected_images = {
+            "full_question_sha256": sha256_bytes(full_image["bytes"]),
+            "right_edge_marks_sha256": sha256_bytes(mark_image["bytes"]),
+        }
+        if row.get("image_inventory") != expected_images:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"terminal_image_inventory_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        if (package / "full-question.jpg").read_bytes() != full_image["bytes"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"full_image_sidecar_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        if (package / "right-edge-marks.jpg").read_bytes() != mark_image["bytes"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"mark_image_sidecar_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        evaluated = evaluate(
+            source,
+            row.get("full_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"),
+            row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"),
+            truth[question_id]["expected"],
+        )
+        status, warnings = terminal_status(
+            evaluated,
+            row.get("full_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"),
+            None if row.get("full_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate") is not None else "full_pass_failed_after_retries",
+            None,
+        )
+        rescored_row = {**row, **evaluated, "terminal_status": status, "warnings": warnings}
+        for key in EVALUATED_KEYS + ("terminal_status",):
+            if row.get(key) != rescored_row.get(key):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"checkpoint_rescore_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}:{key}")
+        rescored.append(rescored_row)
+    documents = _documents(rescored, manifest, truth, selected, selection, truth_path, runner_sha)
+    run_hashes = _write_documents(run_root, documents)
+    output_hashes = _write_documents(output_dir, documents)
+    if run_hashes != output_hashes:
+        raise RuntimeError("compact_artifact_copy_mismatch_global_stop")
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_deterministic_reconstruction_receipt_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "selection": selection,
+        "question_count": len(selected),
+        "checkpoint_sha256": sha256_file(checkpoint),
+        "compact_artifact_sha256": run_hashes,
+        "provider_calls_during_reconstruction": 0,
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+    }

+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    first, warnings = normalize_full_candidate(
+        full_candidate,
+        source["question_number"],
+        multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1,
+    )
+    final, disposition, mark_warnings = merge_mark_pass(
+        first, mark_candidate, full_parseable=first is not None
+    )
+    first_checks = batch.checks(first, expected)
+    final_checks = batch.checks(final, expected)
+    warnings = sorted(set(warnings + mark_warnings + [
+        f"field_disagreement:{field}" for field, passed in final_checks.items() if not passed
+    ]))
+    return {
+        "question_id": source["question_id"],
+        "paper_id": source["paper_id"],
+        "question_number": source["question_number"],
+        "page_chain": source["complete_page_chain"],
+        "source_crop_sha256": [row["crop_sha256"] for row in source["regions"]],
+        "strict_full_schema": base.strict_full_schema(full_candidate),
+        "first_pass_normalized": first,
+        "normalized": final,
+        "mark_pass_disposition": disposition,
+        "warnings": warnings,
+        "first_pass_checks": first_checks,
+        "checks": final_checks,
+        "first_pass_all_field_checks_pass": all(first_checks.values()),
+        "all_field_checks_pass": all(final_checks.values()),
+    }
+
+
+def merge_mark_pass(
+    normalized: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    mark_candidate: Any,
+    *,
+    full_parseable: bool,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str, list[str]]:
+    """Merge ownerless values only when positional alignment is fail-closed."""
+    if not full_parseable or normalized is None:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_not_merged_full_unparseable"]
+    if isinstance(mark_candidate, dict) and "visible_marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+        if "marks_in_reading_order" in mark_candidate:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_multiple_shapes_ambiguous"]
+        rows = mark_candidate["visible_marks_in_reading_order"]
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_rows_invalid"]
+        full_owners = [row["owner"] for row in normalized["visible_marks"]]
+        parsed_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        for row in rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_row_invalid"]
+            owner = base.normalize_label(row.get("owner"))
+            if owner is not None and re.fullmatch(r"(?:i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)", owner):
+                nested_matches = [value for value in full_owners if value.endswith(f"({owner})")]
+                if len(nested_matches) == 1:
+                    owner = nested_matches[0]
+            marks = row.get("marks")
+            if owner is None or type(marks) is not int or marks <= 0:
+                return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_or_value_invalid"]
+            parsed_rows.append({"owner": owner, "marks": marks})
+        parsed_owners = [row["owner"] for row in parsed_rows]
+        if parsed_owners != full_owners:
+            return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", ["mark_pass_owner_sequence_mismatch"]
+        merged = dict(normalized)
+        merged["visible_marks"] = parsed_rows
+        return merged, "merged", []
+    values, error = base.parse_mark_values(mark_candidate)
+    if error:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [error]
+    owners = normalized["visible_marks"]
+    if len(values) != len(owners):
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_count_mismatch:{len(values)}!={len(owners)}"]
+    current = [row["marks"] for row in owners]
+    differing = [index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(current, values)) if before != after]
+    if len(differing) > 1:
+        return normalized, "preserved_full_pass", [f"mark_pass_alignment_ambiguous:{len(differing)}_positions"]
+    merged = dict(normalized)
+    merged["visible_marks"] = [
+        {"owner": row["owner"], "marks": value} for row, value in zip(owners, values)
+    ]
+    return merged, "merged", []
+
+
+def terminal_status(
+    evaluated: dict[str, Any], full_candidate: Any, full_error: str | None, mark_error: str | None
+) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    warnings = list(evaluated["warnings"])
+    if full_error:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if mark_error:
+        warnings.append("mark_pass_failed_after_retries")
+    if full_error and full_candidate is None:
+        status = "full_pass_failed_after_retries"
+    elif evaluated["normalized"] is None:
+        warnings.append("full_pass_unnormalizable")
+        status = "full_pass_unnormalizable"
+    else:
+        status = "candidate_complete_with_warnings" if warnings else "candidate_complete"
+    return status, sorted(set(warnings))
+
+
+def _grid(images: list[Any], gap: int, mode: str) -> Any:
+    Image, _, _ = base._pillow()
+    columns = min(2, len(images))
+    rows = (len(images) + columns - 1) // columns
+    widths = [max((images[i].width for i in range(column, len(images), columns)), default=0) for column in range(columns)]
+    heights = [max(images[i].height for i in range(row * columns, min((row + 1) * columns, len(images)))) for row in range(rows)]
+    canvas = Image.new(mode, (sum(widths) + gap * (columns - 1), sum(heights) + gap * (rows - 1)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for row in range(rows):
+        x = 0
+        for column in range(columns):
+            index = row * columns + column
+            if index < len(images):
+                canvas.paste(images[index], (x, y))
+            x += widths[column] + gap
+        y += heights[row] + gap
+    return canvas
+
+
+def build_question_images(regions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Present multi-page evidence as compact reading-order panels."""
+    if not isinstance(regions, list) or not regions:
+        raise RuntimeError("question_regions_missing_global_stop")
+    Image, ImageEnhance, ImageOps = base._pillow()
+    images = []
+    for region in regions:
+        with Image.open(Path(region["crop_external_path"])) as image:
+            images.append(image.convert("RGB"))
+    full = _grid(images, 30, "RGB")
+    full_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    full.save(full_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=90, optimize=True)
+    strips = []
+    for image in images:
+        strip = image.convert("L").crop((int(image.width * 0.65), 0, image.width, image.height))
+        strip = ImageEnhance.Contrast(ImageOps.autocontrast(strip)).enhance(1.5)
+        strips.append(strip.resize((strip.width * 3, strip.height * 3)))
+    mark = Image.new(
+        "L",
+        (max(strip.width for strip in strips), sum(strip.height for strip in strips) + 60 * (len(strips) - 1)),
+        "white",
+    )
+    mark_y = 0
+    for strip in strips:
+        mark.paste(strip, (0, mark_y))
+        mark_y += strip.height + 60
+    mark_buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    mark.save(mark_buffer, format="JPEG", quality=95, optimize=True)
+    return (
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": full_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(full.size)},
+        {"mime": "image/jpeg", "bytes": mark_buffer.getvalue(), "dimensions": list(mark.size)},
+    )
+
+
+class Issue1631Transport(base.LocalOpenAITransport):
+    def request_metadata(self, prompt: str, image: dict[str, Any], max_tokens: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        metadata = super().request_metadata(prompt, image, max_tokens)
+        metadata["prompt_version"] = PROMPT_VERSION
+        return metadata
+
+
+def selected_ids(manifest: dict[str, Any], selection: str) -> list[str]:
+    all_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    index_rows(manifest["questions"], "question_id", "manifest_question")
+    if selection == "full":
+        return all_ids
+    if selection != "targeted" or len(TARGET_IDS) != 10 or len(set(TARGET_IDS)) != 10:
+        raise RuntimeError("target_selection_invalid_global_stop")
+    if any(question_id not in all_ids for question_id in TARGET_IDS):
+        raise RuntimeError("target_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    return list(TARGET_IDS)
+
+
+def validate_terminal(
+    row: dict[str, Any], *, question_id: str, run_id: str, manifest_sha: str,
+    truth_sha: str, selection_sha: str, runner_sha: str
+) -> None:
+    expected = {
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "question_id": question_id,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "input_manifest_sha256": manifest_sha,
+        "independent_truth_sha256": truth_sha,
+        "selection_sha256": selection_sha,
+        "model": base.DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
+        "repair_runner_file_sha256": runner_sha,
+        "base_runner_file_sha256": batch.MERGED_RUNNER_FILE_SHA256,
+        "max_retries_per_request": MAX_RETRIES,
+    }
+    if any(row.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"terminal_provenance_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+
+
+def _verify_attempts(package: Path, pass_name: str, attempts: Any) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(attempts, list) or len(attempts) > MAX_RETRIES + 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_history_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+    for ordinal, record in enumerate(attempts, 1):
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get("attempt_number") != ordinal:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_ordinal_invalid_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        prefix = package / "attempts" / f"{pass_name}-{ordinal:02d}"
+        metadata = prefix.with_suffix(".metadata.json")
+        request = prefix.with_suffix(".request.json")
+        raw = prefix.with_suffix(".response.raw.json")
+        if not metadata.is_file() or read_json(metadata) != record:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_metadata_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        if not request.is_file() or read_json(request) != record.get("request"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_request_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+        response_sha = record.get("response_sha256")
+        if response_sha is not None and (not raw.is_file() or sha256_file(raw) != response_sha):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"attempt_response_mismatch_global_stop:{pass_name}")
+
+
+def _comparison(summary: dict[str, Any], rows: list[dict[str, Any]], selection: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    baseline_summary = read_json(PARENT_SUMMARY)
+    baseline = index_rows(read_json(PARENT_CANDIDATES)["rows"], "question_id", "baseline_candidate")
+    current = index_rows(rows, "question_id", "current_candidate")
+    original_correct = {question_id for question_id, row in baseline.items() if row["all_field_checks_pass"]}
+    regressions = sorted(question_id for question_id in original_correct if question_id in current and not current[question_id]["all_field_checks_pass"])
+    before_after = {
+        "strict_schema": {"before": baseline_summary["strict_full_schema"], "after": summary["strict_full_schema"]},
+        "fully_correct": {"before": baseline_summary["final_end_to_end"], "after": summary["final_end_to_end"]},
+    }
+    for field in batch.FIELDS:
+        before_after[field] = {
+            "before": baseline_summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+            "after": summary["final_field_checks"][field],
+        }
+    return {
+        "immutable_baseline_issue": 1629,
+        "immutable_baseline_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+        "selection": selection,
+        "before_after": before_after,
+        "normalization_failures": {
+            "before": baseline_summary["provider"]["terminal_full_unnormalizable_count"],
+            "after": sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows),
+        },
+        "model_disagreements_after": sum(row["normalized"] is not None and not row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows),
+        "original_correct_row_count": len(original_correct),
+        "original_correct_regression_count": len(regressions),
+        "original_correct_regression_question_ids": regressions,
+    }

+def _documents(
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]], manifest: dict[str, Any], truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    selected: list[str], selection: str, truth_path: Path, runner_sha: str
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    questions = index_rows(manifest["questions"], "question_id", "manifest_question")
+    selected_manifest = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
+    selected_manifest["questions"] = [questions[question_id] for question_id in selected]
+    selected_truth = {question_id: truth[question_id] for question_id in selected}
+    provenance = {
+        "mode": "candidate_blind_official_page_repair",
+        "path": truth_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(truth_path),
+        "parent_truth_sha256": PARENT_TRUTH_SHA256,
+    }
+    summary, candidates, residual = batch.finalize(rows, selected_manifest, selected_truth, provenance)
+    normalization_failures = sum(row["normalized"] is None for row in rows)
body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep provider failures out of normalization counts**

When the full-pass provider exhausts all retries, the terminal row has `normalized == None`, so this expression counts the provider outage as a normalization failure. The summary already reports terminal provider failures separately, and `_comparison()` uses the baseline's `terminal_full_unnormalizable_count`, so a run with provider failures gets both a misleading category and a non-equivalent before/after normalization metric. Count only rows whose terminal status is `full_pass_unnormalizable` and categorize exhausted requests separately.
